title: Value lists for AI/BI dashboard parameters are generally available
body: You can add a value list to a SQL dataset or local metric view parameter so that viewers pick from a fixed, ordered set of values in the parameter's filter. Add the list in the **Value** section of the **Parameter details** dialog. Viewers can still enter any value that fits the parameter's type. See [Add a value list to a parameter](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters/parameters#value-lists).
